dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はじめに、年齢と性別をお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: To start, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: はい、17歳男です
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm a 17-year-old male.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどのような相談内容になりますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Well,

dialogue.origin: 自分に自信が持てないのがずっと続いてて
dialogue.content: I've been struggling with a lack of self-confidence for a long time.

dialogue.origin: 辛いです
dialogue.content: It's really hard for me.

dialogue.origin: そっかぁ、自分に自信が持てないと辛いよね。。
dialogue.content: I see. It can be really painful when you don't feel confident in yourself.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、もう毎日嫌になってきます
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm starting to dread each day.

dialogue.origin: まわりは考えすぎだっていうけど
dialogue.content: People around me say I'm overthinking it, but...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 自信がないと感じるのは自分自身だし
dialogue.content: But I'm the one who feels this lack of confidence,

dialogue.origin: どうすればいいんだろう？みたいな
dialogue.content: so I'm like, what am I supposed to do?

dialogue.origin: なるほどね。自分のことは一番自分がわかるもんね。。。どの辺が嫌に感じるの？
dialogue.content: I see. You know yourself best, after all. What aspects of it are making you feel this way?

dialogue.origin: 外見がひたすらにコンプレックスです。目元とか。みんなに茶化されたりもして、自分自身でももともと好きじゃなくて。
dialogue.content: My appearance is a huge source of insecurity—especially around my eyes. People tease me about it, and I never really liked it myself to begin with.

dialogue.origin: あ、別にいじめられてるわけではなくて、
dialogue.content: Oh, it's not that I'm being bullied or anything,

dialogue.origin: みんな仲良しなんですけど
dialogue.content: We're all good friends, but...

dialogue.origin: 茶化されるってことはやっぱおかしいんだよね？ってなって、でも周りは考えすぎ、みたいな
dialogue.content: but being teased makes me think, "So there must be something wrong with me, right?" And then people tell me I'm overthinking it.

dialogue.origin: 女々しいんすけどね
dialogue.content: I know it probably sounds kind of weak or overly sensitive.

dialogue.origin: 茶化されるのは仲が良いからっていうのも一つあるかもしれないど、コンプレックスを茶化されるのは、いろいろ自分の中で考えてしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: Sometimes teasing happens because you're close, but when it's about a real insecurity, it can stir up a lot inside.

dialogue.origin: ですね、もう鏡みたくないんですよね、まぁマスクのおかげでだいぶ隠れるんですが
dialogue.content: Exactly. I don't even want to look in the mirror anymore, though thankfully masks hide a lot of it.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: そこまで、考えられているんですね。
dialogue.content: You've been thinking about this a great deal.

dialogue.origin: 友達にはなんて茶化されるの？
dialogue.content: What do your friends say when they tease you?

dialogue.origin: 目が細いのがコンプレックスなんですけど、「今日もほっせえな〜〜」みたいな感じ
dialogue.content: I'm insecure about my narrow eyes, and they'll say something like, "Wow, your eyes are super narrow today, too!"

dialogue.origin: みんないいやつらだし一緒にふざけたりできる中なんですけどね
dialogue.content: They're all good guys, and we're close enough to joke around with each other.

dialogue.origin: 嫌だからやめてくんない？とは言えないんですよね
dialogue.content: But I can't bring myself to say, "I don't like that—can you stop?"

dialogue.origin: そっかぁ。目が細いことをいじられるんですね。相手も真剣じゃないから、急にやめろよとかいう対応もとりたくないですよね。言われた時はどんな対応をとっているの？
dialogue.content: I see—they tease you about your narrow eyes. Since they aren't being serious, you don't want to suddenly snap at them to stop. How do you usually respond in the moment?

dialogue.origin: そうですそうです。うーん、はいはい、って感じで流してるかな
dialogue.content: Right, exactly. I kind of just brush it off with a "yeah, yeah."

dialogue.origin: 自虐とかには
dialogue.content: As for self-deprecating jokes,

dialogue.origin: 走らないかな
dialogue.content: I don't really go there.

dialogue.origin: 流しているとき、心ではいろいろ考えちゃうよね。。。
dialogue.content: Even when you brush it off, I imagine a lot runs through your mind.

dialogue.origin: ですねー…こんなことしてるせいでみんな辞めてくんないのかな、って。
dialogue.content: Yeah... I wonder if the way I react is why they don't stop.

dialogue.origin: 考えすぎるのも、言われるから意識しすぎてるからだと思うし
dialogue.content: And I probably overthink it because I'm too self-conscious about it, since they always mention it.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: どうしたもんですかねすいません曖昧なんですけど
dialogue.content: I'm not sure what to do. Sorry for being so vague.

dialogue.origin: そんなことないと思いますよ。誰でも身体にコンプレックス言わないけど、あると思うし、私もありますよ。
dialogue.content: Not at all. Everyone has insecurities about their body—even if they don't talk about them. I do too.

dialogue.origin: そうかー、たしかに…
dialogue.content: Oh, I see... That's true...

dialogue.origin: うんうん、なかなか自分と向き合うというのは難しいですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, facing yourself can be really difficult.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。なんとも
dialogue.content: Yeah. It's hard to put into words.

dialogue.origin: けど、なんか割と話してるだけでスッキリしてきた感じもあります笑
dialogue.content: But, you know, I feel a little better just from talking about it, haha.

dialogue.origin: なんというか
dialogue.content: How should I put it...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I'm listening.

dialogue.origin: みんな持ってるって感覚は忘れてたな、と
dialogue.content: I'd forgotten that everyone has insecurities.

dialogue.origin: なんか、みんな持ってて、そういうの触れてほしくないけど
dialogue.content: It's like, everyone has them, and they don't want people to touch on those subjects, but...

dialogue.origin: みんなからしたら、そういう普通の仲じゃ触れたくないことを茶化し合うのが、
dialogue.content: from their perspective, teasing each other about things you wouldn't normally bring up with just any friend,

dialogue.origin: なんかこう、あいつらなりの友情というか、受け入れてくれる形なのかもみたいな
dialogue.content: ...is maybe their way of showing friendship, a way of showing they accept me.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: ってことは、こっちからも茶化し返せばいいですかね？笑
dialogue.content: So, does that mean I should tease them back? Haha.

dialogue.origin: あなたはあなたですもんね。
dialogue.content: You're you, after all.

dialogue.origin: 茶化すってとても難しいよね。
dialogue.content: Teasing can be very tricky, can't it?

dialogue.origin: 仲良くない人に茶化すというのは失礼になるし
dialogue.content: Teasing someone you aren't close with can come off as rude,

dialogue.origin: 仲良いからといって茶化が限度を超えると、不快に感じる。
dialogue.content: and even among close friends, if it goes too far, it can feel uncomfortable.

dialogue.origin: そこの具合が上手い人もいれば、下手な人もいる。
dialogue.content: Some people are good at finding that balance; others aren't.

dialogue.origin: って私は考えてるんだけど、どうかな？
dialogue.content: At least, that's how I see it. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですそうです。
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: 本当その通り
dialogue.content: That's absolutely right.

dialogue.origin: 俺はあいつら好きだし、けれど相手を茶化したくはないんですよね
dialogue.content: I like those guys, but I don't want to tease them back.

dialogue.origin: 友情の捉え方？が違うのかな
dialogue.content: Maybe we just have different ways of understanding friendship?

dialogue.origin: 無理して茶化すことはないと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: I don't think you need to force yourself to tease them back.

dialogue.origin: ですよね
dialogue.content: You're right.

dialogue.origin: なんて言えばいいんだろう。俺にとってはそれ違うから！みたいなのが伝えたいけど
dialogue.content: What should I say, though? I want to convey something like, "That's not cool with me!" but...

dialogue.origin: それで気まずくしたくないんですよね
dialogue.content: ...I don't want to make things awkward.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。そうだなぁ。。。例えば
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. Let's see... For example,

dialogue.origin: 自分のコンプレックスは背が低いことなんですね。
dialogue.content: my own insecurity is that I'm short.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか
dialogue.content: Oh, really?

dialogue.origin: 茶化されたら、「私のコンプレックスをいじるな」とか「気にしてることを言うな」とか素直に”打ち明けてる”かな。
dialogue.content: If someone teases me about it, I'm honest and tell them something like, "Please don't make fun of something I'm insecure about," or "I'm really sensitive about that."

dialogue.origin: あーなるほど
dialogue.content: Ah, I see.

dialogue.origin: それ、友達を否定してるわけじゃないですもんね
dialogue.content: That way, you're not rejecting your friends, are you?

dialogue.origin: うんうん、もちろん一つの自分の例だし無理して言うことはないんだけど、でも友達だから言えるって言うのはあるかな。
dialogue.content: Right. Of course, that's just my example, and you don't have to force yourself. But I do think it's something you can say precisely because they're your friends.

dialogue.origin: シンプルに 「気にしてる」とか「それコンプレックス」とか言うのも一つかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.content: Simply saying, "I'm sensitive about that," or "That's an insecurity of mine," could be one option.

dialogue.origin: そうか、味方につける感じというか
dialogue.content: I see, it's like getting them on your side.

dialogue.origin: うーんそれでも考えすぎだろって言われたら、相談員さんならどうしますか？
dialogue.content: Hmm... but what if they still say, "You're just overthinking it"? What would you do in that situation?

dialogue.origin: 参考までにですけど、「私は私の考えがある」って言うかな？
dialogue.content: Just as a suggestion, I might say, 'Well, I have my own feelings about it.'

dialogue.origin: 確かに、それはもう言い返しようがないですよね
dialogue.content: True, there's no arguing with that.

dialogue.origin: そしたら本気だって伝わりそう
dialogue.content: That would probably show them I'm serious.

dialogue.origin: うんうん。コンプレックスも人それぞれだし、あなたはあなた、相手は相手ですしね。
dialogue.content: Exactly. Everyone's insecurities are different. You are you, and they are them.

dialogue.origin: 言えるかなぁちょっと怖いです笑
dialogue.content: I wonder if I can say it... It's a bit scary, haha.

dialogue.origin: 自分の考えとか言おうとすると息が詰まるというか
dialogue.content: When I try to express my own thoughts, it feels like I'm suffocating.

dialogue.origin: なんか泣きそうになるんですよね情けない話ですけど
dialogue.content: I feel like I'm about to cry. I know it's pathetic.

dialogue.origin: 自分のことを話すってとても怖いですよね。
dialogue.content: It's very scary to talk about yourself, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 怖いです。気持ちをだすのって一人になるのが怖い感じ
dialogue.content: It is scary. Expressing my feelings makes me feel afraid of being left alone.

dialogue.origin: そうか、僕って外見のコンプレックスっていうか
dialogue.content: I see... so for me, it's not just the insecurity about my looks...

dialogue.origin: そういうとこ？ハブられたりするのが嫌だったのかもです
dialogue.content: it's more that I was afraid of being excluded.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 大事な感情ですよね。
dialogue.content: That's a very important feeling.

dialogue.origin: でも私はこうしてあなたが、本当のことを打ち明けてもらい、嬉しかったりもします。
dialogue.content: But I, for one, am happy that you've been able to open up and share your true feelings with me.

dialogue.origin: 本当ですか
dialogue.content: Really?

dialogue.origin: え？もしかして、本当のことを話して、
dialogue.content: Huh? You mean, if I talk about my true feelings,

dialogue.origin: うんうん。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 嫌われるだろ、って考えるのって間違いですか？それで嬉しい人もいる？
dialogue.content: is it wrong for me to think I'll be disliked for it? Are there people who are actually happy to hear it?

dialogue.origin: 間違いってことはないと思う。内容によるんじゃないかな？
dialogue.content: I don't think it's wrong. It probably depends on what you're saying, don't you think?

dialogue.origin: 例えば「お前のこと本当に嫌い」って言われたら傷つきますよね。
dialogue.content: For example, if someone said, "I really hate you," that would be hurtful.

dialogue.origin: でも「私、背の低いこと悩んでて〜」だと相手を傷つけることはないですよね。
dialogue.content: But if you say something like, "I'm feeling insecure about my height," that doesn't hurt the other person, does it?

dialogue.origin: どう思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうか、確かに
dialogue.content: I see, that's true.

dialogue.origin: そこがごっちゃになってたかもしれません
dialogue.content: I might have been mixing those two things up.

dialogue.origin: 思ってること言ったら嫌われるかも、って思ってたけど、何に悩んでるのかとかを話すのっていいことですね
dialogue.content: I used to think I'd be disliked if I said what was on my mind, but talking about what's bothering me is actually a good thing, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 一つの選択肢として良いですよね
dialogue.content: It's a good option to have.

dialogue.origin: なんか、もっと友達のこと信用しようと思いました
dialogue.content: Somehow, I feel like I should trust my friends more.

dialogue.origin: 言っても嫌われる奴らって、友達のこと決めつけてたかもしれないです
dialogue.content: I may have been unfairly judging my friends, assuming they'd dislike me if I spoke up.

dialogue.origin: 凄い、その意見が出るってことは相手も自分も信じれてるからこそですもんね。
dialogue.content: That's amazing. To be able to say that shows you're starting to trust both them and yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい、すみませんなんか、目が細い話どっか行きましたw
dialogue.content: Yes. Sorry, somehow we've strayed completely from the topic of my narrow eyes, haha.

dialogue.origin: 心が軽くなったようで良かったです。応援してます。
dialogue.content: I'm glad it seems your heart feels lighter. I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。やって見ます
dialogue.content: Thank you. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございます。それでは本日の相談を終了させて頂きます。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. We will conclude our session for today.

dialogue.origin: はい！またお願いします
dialogue.content: Okay! I'd like to talk with you again sometime.

topic.sub: 自信のなさとコンプレックスの影響
